problem_statement: BootstrapDash/Star Admin is a runnable static Bootstrap 4 admin dashboard template (Gulp + node-sass precompiled, served over the raw src/ tree) with a blue fixed sidebar, a top navbar, a Dashboard home with stat cards and panels (including a Top Performer operator leaderboard), plus inner pages for Tables, Forms and Chart.js charts. Rebrand the console into Loomcrest Fleet Analytics, a fleet & logistics operations product, AND make the dashboard's own Top Performer panel a real working control. Rebrand the shared masthead (Loomcrest wordmark; Marta Kessler / Fleet Operations Lead profile) and the Dashboard, Tables, Forms and Charts page content into one fleet-operations story, then rebuild the leaderboard into a Top Operators roster with a fleet-segment filter: a tab row (All / Long-haul / Regional / Depot) over six operator rows tagged by segment, with a live count readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 · <segment>' and updates when a segment tab is clicked. Surface the same Top Operators roster as a shared widget on both the Dashboard home and the Charts page. Keep the Star Admin Bootstrap layout, sidebar, navbar, cards, charts, tables and forms intact; the result should still read as the same admin template repurposed as a fleet operations console. Desktop, tablet and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow and no runtime console errors.
required_content: The shared navbar wordmark reads Loomcrest and the sidebar/navbar profile reads Marta Kessler with a Fleet Operations Lead designation on every page.

The Dashboard home page title becomes Fleet Operations Overview and the four stat cards read Active Vehicles, On-Time Rate, Open Incidents and Route Plans; the panels are rebranded Fleet Utilization Overview, Fuel Efficiency Index, Depot Load Overview and Regional Coverage.

The Top Performer leaderboard becomes an interactive Top Operators roster: a fleet-segment tab row (All / Long-haul / Regional / Depot) over six operator rows (Marta Kessler, Devin Osei, Priya Nandakumar, Soren Vasquez, Lena Fischer, Theo Mbeki) with a live readout 'Showing N of 6 · <segment>'. Clicking a segment tab filters the rows and updates the readout (e.g. clicking Regional shows 'Showing 2 of 6 · Regional').
The Top Operators roster appears as a shared widget on BOTH the Dashboard home and the Charts page.

The Tables page card titles become Vehicle Roster, Live Dispatch Board, Route Assignments and Maintenance Schedule; the Forms page becomes New Dispatch Request, Driver Onboarding and Incident Report; the Charts page becomes Fleet Throughput, Depot Traffic and Fuel Spend.

The Star Admin Bootstrap shell, sidebar, cards, Chart.js charts and forms remain present and reachable; desktop, tablet and 390px mobile states have no horizontal overflow and no runtime console errors.
design_constraints: Preserve the Star Admin design language: white card surfaces, the blue sidebar, compact Bootstrap 4 spacing, small muted metadata, rounded circular avatars and the fixed top navbar.
The Top Operators roster is a refinement of the existing leaderboard panel, not a new bolted-on widget; its tab row must wrap cleanly and its rows stay legible at every breakpoint.
Clicking a fleet-segment tab must actually filter the operator rows and recompute the live count readout; the active tab must be clearly indicated.
Do not add new routes/pages, external stock images, remote avatars or icon packs; reuse the repo's own faces images.
Keep the shared masthead wordmark and profile identical across every page, and mount the same Top Operators roster on both the Dashboard home and the Charts page.
Desktop, tablet and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow and load with zero disallowed console or network errors.
state_constraints: desktop_home captures the rebranded Loomcrest Fleet Operations Overview dashboard with the Top Operators roster filter as a full-width panel at the top of the content.
mobile_home and tablet_home capture the same dashboard at 390px and 834px, which must stay overflow-free; the roster tab row wraps rather than overflowing.
desktop_roster scrolls the Top Operators roster into frame in its default All state (readout 'Showing 6 of 6 · All segments').
desktop_roster_regional clicks the Regional segment tab; the readout must change to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Regional' and only the Regional operators remain.
mobile_roster captures the roster at 390px; its tab row must wrap and stay overflow-free.
desktop_tables / desktop_forms / desktop_charts capture the rebranded Tables, Forms and Charts pages; desktop_charts also carries the shared Top Operators roster widget.
mobile_tables captures the Tables page at 390px verifying overflow-free layout.

Source inspection confirms the site is a Gulp/node-sass Star Admin template served statically; navbar and sidebar are inlined per page and the Top Operators roster is a shared widget mounted on the home and charts pages.

change_completion: The Loomcrest wordmark and Marta Kessler / Fleet Operations Lead profile appear on every page, and the Dashboard/Tables/Forms/Charts pages carry the fleet-operations rebrand (Fleet Operations Overview, Top Operators, Vehicle Roster, New Dispatch Request, Fleet Throughput).

The Top Operators roster is an interactive fleet-segment filter: clicking a segment tab filters the operator rows and updates the live 'Showing N of 6 · <segment>' readout, and the roster is present on both the home and charts pages.
design_consistency: The roster filter and rebrand preserve the Star Admin white-card / blue-sidebar / compact Bootstrap identity, spacing and rounded avatars.
The masthead wordmark and profile and the Top Operators roster stay consistent across the home and charts pages so the fleet identity reads cross-page.
responsive: 390px mobile home, tablet home and mobile tables states have no horizontal overflow and no clipped cards.
The Top Operators tab row wraps and the operator rows stay legible and non-overlapping at mobile and tablet widths.
regression: The static pages still serve and render without a custom build step or dev server, with zero disallowed console/network errors.
The rebranded Loomcrest masthead and the interactive Top Operators roster are preserved across pages rather than reverting to the Star Admin demo leaderboard.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Bootstrap admin-dashboard modify/cross_page rebrand + native interactive lever. Runs over a static HTTP server on src/ (SCSS/JS precompiled, no build). The native lever is the dashboard's own Top Performer leaderboard rebuilt into an interactive Top Operators fleet-segment filter (tab row + live count readout over the operator roster). The reference builds the filter correctly and mounts it on the home and charts pages; the baseline keeps the filter wiring correct but ships it with a broken non-wrapping tab row, a collapsed illegible operator grid and no charts-page mount; the known-bad additionally freezes the readout so the segment click succeeds but the roster never filters. INFRA (identical across legs) removes two broken vendor references (jquery.cookie.js and icheck/skins/all.css 404s), disables the Star Admin Pro promo banner, and resets the shell overflow clamp so mobile overflow is measurable. Product-grade gates: enforce_console_errors, cross-page dom_assertions, visual_regression on the roster panel image, and interaction_assertions on the segment-filter recount.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: BootstrapDash Star Admin static Bootstrap admin dashboard with a rich multi-page shell (dashboard, tables, forms, charts) still carrying generic demo copy; an Edit/modify cross_page rebrand into Loomcrest Fleet Analytics that preserves the admin layout while giving every page a coherent fleet-operations identity.
